comment: Golden-set evaluation prompts. Run with server/golden-set.ps1 after vLLM is up. Each category checks that the model returns parseable JSON in the shape the app expects. This measures STRUCTURAL accuracy (JSON validity + required fields) - spot-check factual quality manually.

categories.name: quiz_generation
categories.system: You are a technical interviewer. Return ONLY valid JSON.
prompts: Generate 5 technical interview questions to assess a candidate for a "Software Engineer" role. Each item must have "question", "options" (exactly 4), and "correctAnswer" (one of the options verbatim). Return a JSON object: {"questions": [...]}.

Generate 5 technical interview questions to assess a candidate for a "Data Analyst" role. Each item must have "question", "options" (exactly 4), and "correctAnswer". Return a JSON object: {"questions": [...]}.

Generate 5 technical interview questions for a "Machine Learning Engineer" role. Each item must have "question", "options" (exactly 4), and "correctAnswer". Return {"questions": [...]}.
Generate 5 technical interview questions for a "Cloud Engineer" role. Each item must have "question", "options" (exactly 4), and "correctAnswer". Return {"questions": [...]}.
